title: An uncertainty marker scopes over one proposition
summary: A narrow hedge hypothesis marks exactly one proposition as uncertain while leaving adjacent propositions unhedged; a global confidence mode would spread the uncertainty.

design.unit: multi-proposition records with one candidate hedge and independently separated propositions
design.contrast: local hedge versus record-wide confidence mode
design.prediction: Only the proposition immediately selected by the hedge should receive an uncertainty flag; an adjacent proposition should retain its ordinary status under fixed boundaries.
design.countermodel: Editorial correction or omitted context could create the same pattern without a repair or hedge operator.
design.falsifier: The hedge changes every proposition in the record, or changes a nonselected proposition while leaving its selected target unchanged.
design.principal_risk: Independent uncertainty judgments are unavailable. Near IDEA000070 provenance and GDT710/730 confidence renderers, but targets semantic scope of uncertainty rather than source status or confidence display.
